label: June 22–28
title: “Hear Thou in Heaven Their Prayer” —  2 Samuel 11–12; 1 Kings 3; 6

items.text: Human weaknesses and temptation can lead to tragedy when we put our own desires before the Lord’s. Yet, the temple covenants create a connection to God, securing the promise that through repentance and His mercy, He can dwell among us and never forsake us.

Even those who seem strong in faith face temptation. David’s choices demonstrate that no one is immune to sin. We must learn from these experiences and actively choose righteousness to stay spiritually safe from the adversary’s enticements.

The adversary constantly seeks to lead us down sinful paths. We must make conscious choices now to remain spiritually safe, understanding that Jesus Christ will help us return to the Lord when we falter.
The Lord desires to help us see ourselves more accurately. His love and guidance enable us to understand our true worth and the path back to Him, even after making poor choices.
A warning for us is to be vigilant against choices that lead to sin. David’s story teaches the profound dangers of succumbing to temptation and the sorrow that follows such decisions.
When faced with temptation, we can find strength in the Savior. Hymns like 'I Need Thee Every Hour' remind us of His constant support and power to help us overcome difficulties.
The gift of discernment, to distinguish between good and bad, is invaluable. Seeking an understanding heart from the Lord allows us to make righteous choices and navigate life’s challenges wisely.
The Lord offers us the choice to ask for anything. Solomon’s wise request for an understanding heart shows us the ultimate value of seeking spiritual wisdom over worldly possessions.

The detailed accounts of Solomon’s temple highlight its sacred importance to the Israelites. This house of the Lord represented His enduring presence among His people, a symbol of His covenant relationship.
Through the covenants made in the Lord’s house, even the temple, we can feel His presence. This sacred space assures us that the Lord dwells with us and will not forsake us.
